fato_historico: 1899: Ulises Heureaux, the 27th President of the Dominican Republic, is assassinated.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a shifting tide, Gemini. Just as historical figures teach us about the fragility of power and the importance of legacy, you might find it a good time to reflect on your own influence. Consider how your voice shapes your world. Focus on clarity, communication, and embracing the unexpected beauty that transitions often bring.
frase_do_dia: Every ending creates space for a new and vibrant beginning to bloom.
significado_numero: Represents the power of introspection and building a lasting personal legacy.
conselho: Speak your truth with kindness and listen deeply to the wisdom around you.
